title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: Banda keeps pressing toward sovereignty, speaks in increasingly royal terms, and moves through places such as Gurdaspur while severing himself from the Khalsa body.
The Singhs, however, see that outside the Khalsa he has become vulnerable rather than stronger, whatever worldly display he tries to maintain.
Gurdaspur is the page’s firm geographic anchor because it marks the path of Banda’s independent movement.
